name: Cube CanvasRect Texture D3D11
description: XR_DXR_canvas_rect (#697) windowless-producer test: a shared-texture app that passes NO HWND and instead declares its on-panel canvas rect (display-relative px) via XrCanvasRectBindingDXR + xrSetCanvasRectDXR. Proves canvas-scoped Kooima + weave phase come from the declared rect, not a bound window.
